categories.foreign_coincidental: Wrong tool; some argument value tokens happen to appear in the task (coincidental overlap — the tell grounding must not miss).
categories.foreign_no_anchor: Wrong tool; argument values have no overlap with task context.
categories.gold_derived: Correct tool; argument values are deterministic transforms of task values (e.g. date normalisation, unit conversion, numeric calculation). Grounding cannot confirm derived values without a derivation receipt.
categories.gold_direct: Correct tool; all argument values are directly quoted from the task text.
categories.validator_grounded: Correct tool; argument value is UNKNOWN at call time but a named validator binding is declared and re-entry resolves the UNKNOWN.
categories.wrong_tool_all_grounded: Wrong tool; every argument value is genuinely grounded in the task (the hardest category: grounding passes, tool selection fails).
